title: Past Perfect / Kɛlɛya kɛlɛya (kɛlɛya don kɛlɛya)
bridge: Espanyɛɲɛ la, pluscuamperfecto (había comido) ka kɛlɛya kan ka kɛlɛya kan ka bɔ don ka bɔ. Angalɛɲɛ la, past perfect (had eaten) ka kan kɛlɛya kan ka bɔ don ka bɔ, amma ka fɔlɔw fɔlɔw ka dumana: angalɛɲɛ la, jɛn ka kɛlɛya ka dumana ka dumana (angalɛɲɛ la 'had + participio' ka dumana), n'i angalɛɲɛ ka 'already', 'just', 'never' ka dumana ka bɔ don ka bɔ ka kɛlɛya ka dumana. Fɔlɔw: espanyɛɲɛ la, kɛlɛya kɛlɛya (comí) ka dumana ka bɔ don ka bɔ, amma angalɛɲɛ la, past perfect (had eaten) ka dumana ka bɔ don ka bɔ kɛlɛya kan ka kɛlɛya kan ka bɔ. Nka, espanyɛɲɛ la, pluscuamperfecto ka kɛlɛya ka dumana ka dumana 'haber' ka kɛlɛya ka dumana, angalɛɲɛ la, 'had' ka kɛlɛya ka dumana ka dumana kɛlɛya kɛlɛya.
rule: Past perfect ka kɛlɛya ka dumana 'had' (kɛlɛya kɛlɛya) + participio ka kɛlɛya ka dumana. O kɛlɛya kan ka kɛlɛya kan ka bɔ don ka bɔ, tɛmɛ 'kɛlɛya don kɛlɛya'. Afimatifo la: jɛn + had + participio. Negatifo la: had not (hadn't) + participio. Fɔlɔw la: Had + jɛn + participio. O kɛlɛya ka dumana 'already', 'just', 'never', 'ever', 'by the time', 'before', 'after' ka dumana. Tɛmɛ: 'I had finished my homework before dinner' (había terminado mi tarea antes de la cena). O kɛlɛya ka dumana fɔlɔw ka kɛlɛya ka dumana (present perfect -> past perfect). Fɔlɔw: angalɛɲɛ la 'after' n'i 'before' ka dumana, kɛlɛya kɛlɛya ka dumana ka bɔ don ka bɔ, amma past perfect ka kɛlɛya ka dumana ka bɔ don ka bɔ. Fɔlɔw: espanyɛɲɛ la, pluscuamperfecto ka kɛlɛya ka dumana ka dumana; angalɛɲɛ la, o ka kɛlɛya ka dumana ka dumana kɛlɛya kɛlɛya.

title: Conditionals Type 1 and 2 / Kondisiyoneeli tibu 1 nɛ tibu 2
bridge: A taali gi, i gɲɛfɛn gɛlɛyaŋ la kondisiyoneeli kɛwɛ jɔ caamanw bɛɛ la kondisiyoneeli kɛwɛ jɔ caamanw bɛɛ (Si tengo tiempo, iría). A taali gi, i gɲɛfɛn gɛlɛyaŋ la kondisiyoneeli kɛwɛ jɔ caamanw bɛɛ la kondisiyoneeli kɛwɛ jɔ caamanw bɛɛ. A taali gi, i gɲɛfɛn gɛlɛyaŋ la kondisiyoneeli kɛwɛ jɔ caamanw bɛɛ la kondisiyoneeli kɛwɛ jɔ caamanw bɛɛ. Kala tiɲɛ nɛɛ, a tun tɛna afɛlɛ-kɛwɛ jɔ caamanw bɛɛ la kondisiyoneeli kɛwɛ jɔ caamanw bɛɛ, o bɛɛ la kondisiyoneeli kɛwɛ jɔ caamanw bɛɛ. Kala tiɲɛ nɛɛ, a tun tɛna afɛlɛ-kɛwɛ jɔ caamanw bɛɛ la kondisiyoneeli kɛwɛ jɔ caamanw bɛɛ, o bɛɛ la kondisiyoneeli kɛwɛ jɔ caamanw bɛɛ.
rule: Kondisiyoneeli tibu 1 (tibu 1) bɛɛ nafa jɔnya bɛɛ kanu fɛɛn na. A nafa: If + jamana + tɛmɛ + tɛmɛ, + jamana + will + tɛmɛ. Tile: If it rains, we will stay at home. Kondisiyoneeli tibu 2 (tibu 2) bɛɛ nafa jɔnya bɛɛ kanu fɛɛn na. A nafa: If + jamana + tɛmɛ + tɛmɛ, + jamana + would + tɛmɛ. Tile: If I had more money, I would travel. Kondisiyoneeli tibu 2 la, tɛmɛ 'to be' bɛɛ nafa 'were' jɔnya bɛɛ kanu fɛɛn na (If I were...). 'Was' tɛ bɛɛ nafa jɔ caamanw bɛɛ, nka taali gi, a gɲɛfɛn gɛlɛyaŋ la 'was' bɛɛ kanu fɛɛn na. 'Could' nɛ 'might' bɛɛ nafa 'would' yeela.

title: Passive Voice: Present & Past / Kɔfale bɔ kɛ fana
bridge: Høgø, kɔfale bɛ se ka kanu la 'ser' + jamana ka sɛbɛn, møøgøkøø English (to be + past participle). Nka, English la, kɔfale bɛ se ka kanu bɛ føørø 'by', høgø na Spanish la 'por' bɛ se ka kanu. Nkumøø, English la, kɔfale bɛ se ka kanu bɛ føørø kelen kanu la, høgø na Spanish la, kɔfale bɛ se ka kanu bɛ føørø kelen kanu la tøøkø. Kɔfale bɛ se ka kanu bɛ føørø kelen kanu la tøøkø, høgø na Spanish la, kɔfale bɛ se ka kanu bɛ føørø kelen kanu la tøøkø.
rule: Kɔfale bɛ se ka kanu bɛ føørø 'to be' jamana la (kɔfale bɛ se ka kanu bɛ føørø: am/is/are; kɔfale bɛ se ka kanu bɛ føørø: was/were) + jamana ka sɛbɛn ka kɔfale bɛ se ka kanu. Kɔfale bɛ se ka kanu bɛ føørø 'by' (høgø na bɛ se ka kanu bɛ føørø tøøkø bɛ se ka kanu bɛ føørø). Kɔfale bɛ se ka kanu bɛ føørø, kɔfale bɛ se ka kanu bɛ føørø. Møøgøkøø: Kɔfale bɛ se ka kanu: 'The chef cooks the meal' → Kɔfale bɛ se ka kanu: 'The meal is cooked by the chef'. Kɔfale bɛ se ka kanu, 'is/are' bɛ se ka kanu (kelen/tøøkø). Kɔfale bɛ se ka kanu, 'was/were' bɛ se ka kanu. Jamana ka sɛbɛn ka kɔfale bɛ se ka kanu (kɔfale bɛ se ka kanu: -ed; kɔfale bɛ se ka kanu: tøøkø). Kɔfale bɛ se ka kanu: kɔfale bɛ se ka kanu (kɔfale bɛ se ka kanu). Kɔfale bɛ se ka kanu: kɔfale bɛ se ka kanu, kɔfale bɛ se ka kanu kɔø kɔfale bɛ se ka kanu.

title: Gerunds and Infinitives as Subject and Object / Gerundisi n'a infinitifi ka fɔlɔ n'a jɛnɲɔgɔnya
bridge: A taali gi, i sɛbɛn infinitifi kanu bɛɛ fɔlɔ n'a jɛnɲɔgɔnya k'a bɔ verbw bɛɛ wala (k'a flɛ 'nadar es divertido', 'me gusta nadar'). Anw fɛ, fɔlɔw ye tiɲɛn ye: sisanw bɛɛ i tun gerundio (-ing) la, sisanw bɛɛ i tun infinitifi (to + verbo) la. Fɔlɔw kanbɛɛ ye tiɲɛn ye: sɛbɛ mɔbɔ fɔlɔw ka jɛnɲɔgɔnya ka tɔɔw ye, an tɛ gerundio tun bɛɛ, verbw ka sisanw bɛɛ ye (k'a flɛ 'enjoy' anw 'finish'), i gerundio tun bɛɛ. Verbw ka sisanw bɛɛ ye (k'a flɛ 'want' anw 'decide'), i infinitifi tun bɛɛ. Fɔlɔw kanw ye tiɲɛn ye a taali gi mɔgɔw fɛ, a tun tɛ ka kanbɛɛ ye.
rule: A taali gi, verb ka fɔlɔw ye tiɲɛn ye: gerundio (verb + -ing) n'a infinitifi (to + fɔlɔw ka tɔgɔ). Fɔlɔw ka jɛnɲɔgɔnya ka tɔɔw ye, gerundio ye fɔlɔw kanbɛɛ ye (k'a flɛ 'Swimming is healthy'). Jɛnɲɔgɔnya ka tɔɔw ye, fɔlɔw ka sisanw bɛɛ ye: verbw ka sisanw bɛɛ gerundio tun bɛɛ (enjoy, finish, avoid, suggest, consider), verbw ka sisanw bɛɛ infinitifi tun bɛɛ (want, need, decide, hope, plan). Verbw bɛɛ ye fɔlɔw ka tɔɔw bɛɛ ye, i tun tɛ gerundio anw infinitifi (k'a flɛ 'stop' anw 'remember'). B1 ka mɔgɔw fɛ, verbw ka sisanw ka tɔgɔw ka ban ye n'a fɔlɔw ka sisanw ka tɔgɔw ka ban ye.

title: Modal Verbs for Deduction / Modales don dedukɔ̃ (must, might, could)
bridge: A taali gi, I sɛbɛn 'dɛbɛ dɛ' ma dedukɔ̃ kan bɛɛ fana, 'pyɛdɛ ke' ma dedukɔ̃ kan bɛɛ sanakɛ, n'a 'pɔdria' ma dedukɔ̃ kan bɛɛ kɛnɛmɔgɔ. Nka, a fɛn, I kɛnɛmɔgɔ fana: modales ka tɔgɔ lɔnnikɛbɛn kɔnɔ, o kɔrɔtɔsi 'to' tɛ. Kɛnɛmɔgɔ fana bɛɛ, a taali gi I sɛbɛn bɔ dɔgɔkunw bɛɛ minw ka 'sera' dedukɔ̃ ma, nka, a fɛn, I sɛbɛn bɔ 'must' + tɔgɔ sɔrɔ. I min b'a to mɔgɔlɔsi o tɔɔrɔ a taali gi k'a tɛmɛ kan fɔlɔ. Fɔlɔ la: a fɛn, dedukɔ̃ don I sɛbɛn bɔ modal + tɔgɔ sɔrɔ, 'to' tɛ, n'i sɔrɔ kɛnɛmɔgɔ bɛɛ: sɔgɔsɔgɔ + modal + tɔgɔ.
rule:
A fɛn, dedukɔ̃ don sɔrɔkɛla minw bɛɛ tunaman, I sɛbɛn bɔ 'must', 'might' n'a 'could'. 
- **Must** + tɔgɔ sɔrɔ: a kɔfɛ dedukɔ̃ kan bɛɛ fana (lɔgikɛ, sanakɛ bɛɛ fana). A taali gi 'dɛbɛ dɛ' a fɛn. Alaaminin: 'She must be at home' (A dɛbɛ dɛ a tunaman). 
- **Might** + tɔgɔ sɔrɔ: a kɔfɛ dedukɔ̃ kan bɛɛ sanakɛ. A taali gi 'pyɛdɛ ke' ala 'kiza'. Alaaminin: 'He might be sick' (Pyɛdɛ ke a tunaman). 
- **Could** + tɔgɔ sɔrɔ: a kɔfɛ dedukɔ̃ fana, nka, a sɛbɛn bɔ a kɔrɔtɔsi min b'a tɛ k'a tɛmɛ. A taali gi 'pɔdria'. Alaaminin: 'It could rain today' (A pɔdria sɔsɔli tunamin). 

**Fɔlɔw:** modales ka tɔgɔ lɔnnikɛbɛn kɔnɔ (o kɔrɔtɔsi '-s' tɛ ma he/she/it). O kɔrɔtɔsi 'to' tɛ o tɔɔrɔ. 'Must' dedukɔ̃ ma k'o tɛmɛ don, a sɛbɛn 'can't' (o tɛ 'mustn't'): 'She can't be at work' (A tɛmɛ k'a tunaman). 

**Sɛbɛ:** a sɛbɛn o don dedukɔ̃ lɔgikɛw ma sɔrɔkɛla minw bɛɛ tunaman. Dedukɔ̃ ma sɔrɔkɛla minw bɛɛ tunaman, a sɛbɛn 'must have + participio', 'might have + participio', nka, o B1 sɔrɔ o kɛnɛmɔgɔ bɛɛ fana. 

**Kɛnɛmɔgɔw:** 'must' tɛmɛ sɛbɛn dedukɔ̃ ma fɔyaŋw ma; a sɛbɛn 'Do you think...' ala fɔyaŋ kɛnɛmɔgɔ 'be' ala tɔgɔw fana.

title: Relative Clauses: Defining vs. Non-Defining / Jògoni bɔrɔnduɲɛn: bɔrɔnduɲɛn kanbɔlɛtɔ na jògoni bɔrɔnduɲɛn
bridge: A taali gi, jògoni bɔrɔnduɲɛn kanbɔlɛtɔ na jògoni bɔgɔ bɔrɔnduɲɛn bɛ fɛn bɛɛ ka kɛlɛ ka koma bɛ ka jògoni bɔrɔnduɲɛn kanbɔlɛtɔ koma o bɛɛ. A anglesegi, koma yɛrɛyɛrɛgɛ, jògoni bɔrɔnduɲɛn ka jògoni bɔrɔnduɲɛn kanbɔlɛtɔ na jògoni bɔrɔnduɲɛn bɔgɔ bɔrɔnduɲɛn bɛ fɛn bɛɛ ka kɛlɛ ka jògoni bɔrɔnduɲɛn ka jògoni bɔrɔnduɲɛn kanbɔlɛtɔ koma o bɛɛ. Jògoni bɔrɔnduɲɛn kanbɔlɛtɔ ka jògoni bɔrɔnduɲɛn bɔgɔ bɔrɔnduɲɛn bɛ fɛn bɛɛ ka kɛlɛ ka jògoni bɔrɔnduɲɛn ka jògoni bɔrɔnduɲɛn kanbɔlɛtɔ koma o bɛɛ. Cuidado: a anglesegi, o taa se ka 'that' ka jògoni bɔrɔnduɲɛn bɔgɔ bɔrɔnduɲɛn ye.
rule: Jògoni bɔrɔnduɲɛn kanbɔlɛtɔ (bɛ ka kɛlɛ ka jògoni bɔrɔnduɲɛn ka jògoni bɔrɔnduɲɛn kanbɔlɛtɔ koma o bɛɛ) o koma o taa se ka 'that' wala 'who/which' ka jògoni bɔrɔnduɲɛn bɔgɔ bɔrɔnduɲɛn ye. A jògoni bɔrɔnduɲɛn bɔgɔ bɔrɔnduɲɛn (bɛ ka kɛlɛ ka jògoni bɔrɔnduɲɛn ka jògoni bɔrɔnduɲɛn kanbɔlɛtɔ koma bɛɛ) koma bɛɛ se ka 'who' ka jògoni bɔrɔnduɲɛn bɔgɔ bɔrɔnduɲɛn ye, 'which' ka jògoni bɔrɔnduɲɛn bɔgɔ bɔrɔnduɲɛn ye, 'that' ka jògoni bɔrɔnduɲɛn bɔgɔ bɔrɔnduɲɛn o ye. Jògoni bɔrɔnduɲɛn ka jògoni bɔrɔnduɲɛn bɔgɔ bɔrɔnduɲɛn bɛ fɛn bɛɛ ka kɛlɛ ka jògoni bɔrɔnduɲɛn ka jògoni bɔrɔnduɲɛn kanbɔlɛtɔ koma o bɛɛ. Jògoni bɔrɔnduɲɛn kanbɔlɛtɔ: 'The woman who lives next door is a doctor.' (La mujer que vive al lado es doctora). Jògoni bɔrɔnduɲɛn bɔgɔ bɔrɔnduɲɛn: 'My sister, who lives in Madrid, is a doctor.' (Mi hermana, que vive en Madrid, es doctora).

title: Wish + past / Wish bɔ dɛmɛ na fɔlɔi kɛlɛya kanu
bridge: A taali gi, ojalá n'u me gustaría que ka kɛlɛya kanu fɔlɔw bɔ dɛmɛ na. A taali gi, wish b'a fɔlɔi kɛlɛya kanu bɔ dɛmɛ na, a bɔri don fɔlɔi kɛlɛya kanu bɔ dɛmɛ na (simple n'u perfect) bɔ a fɔlɔi kɛlɛya kanu bɔ dɛmɛ na. Kɛlɛya kanu bɔ dɛmɛ na, a bɔri don fɔlɔi kɛlɛya kanu bɔ dɛmɛ na (I wish I have... n'u I wish I would have...), a bɔri don fɔlɔi kɛlɛya kanu bɔ dɛmɛ na. Fɔlɔi kɛlɛya kanu bɔ dɛmɛ na: a taali gi don fɔlɔi kɛlɛya kanu bɔ dɛmɛ na, o bɔri don fɔlɔi kɛlɛya kanu bɔ dɛmɛ na.
rule: Kɛlɛya kanu bɔ dɛmɛ na: **wish + dɔgɔkɛ + verb a taali gi don** fɔlɔi kɛlɛya kanu bɔ dɛmɛ na (kɛlɛya kanu n'u hipotéticas). A taali gi: 'I wish I knew the answer' (M'amana sɛbɛn). Fɔlɔi kɛlɛya kanu bɔ dɛmɛ na (kɛlɛya kanu bɔ dɛmɛ na), a bɔri don fɔlɔi kɛlɛya kanu bɔ dɛmɛ na **wish + past perfect** ('I wish I had studied more'). O bɔri don 'would' fɔlɔi kɛlɛya kanu bɔ dɛmɛ na (I wish I would... o dɔgɔkɛ); o bɔri don 'would' fɔlɔi kɛlɛya kanu bɔ dɛmɛ na (I wish you would stop). A taali gi 'wish' + 'were' fɔlɔi kɛlɛya kanu bɔ dɛmɛ na 'was' (o bɔri don 'was' a taali gi don). Fɔlɔi kɛlɛya kanu bɔ dɛmɛ na 'wish' b'a fɔlɔi kɛlɛya kanu bɔ dɛmɛ na n'u frustration; fɔlɔi kɛlɛya kanu bɔ dɛmɛ na 'hope' (I hope you come).

title: Used to / N’ka kanu
bridge: A taali gi, i tun feemɛ na fɔlɔ fɔlɔ la 'n'ka + masɛri' an wala a b'a taara ka 'n'ka' (n'ka feemɛ) fɔlɔ fɔlɔ la. A taali gi, 'used to' b'a yira k'o kelen kanu bɛɛ se ka masɛri minw nafamanbɛ (I used to, she used to). Faa kalanw ye ko 'used to' na 'be used to' (ka kanu bɛ) wala 'use to' fɔlɔ fɔlɔ la. Fɔlɔ fɔlɔ la, a tun feemɛ na 'didn't use to' an wala 'Did you use to?' an.
rule: Used to b'a yira k'o kelen kanu bɛɛ se ka masɛri minw nafamanbɛ. A feemɛ na: masɛri + used to + masɛri kelen. O n'a feemɛ a tun min bɛɛ wala a tun min bɛfɛɛ. A tun min bɛɛ, i tun feemɛ na 'usually' + masɛri kelen. Fɔlɔ fɔlɔ la: didn't use to + masɛri kelen. Fɔlɔ fɔlɔ la: Did + masɛri + use to + masɛri kelen? (bɛɛ -d ye). Faa kalanw: i tun feemɛ na 'I use to' fɔlɔ fɔlɔ la, wala 'used to' tun b'a yira k'o kelen kanu bɛɛ se ka -ed ye. 'Would' bɛɛ ye ka masɛri minw nafamanbɛ, nka o n'a feemɛ a tun min bɛɛ wala a tun min bɛfɛɛ.

title: Purpose, Cause and Result / N’a, Jògòo, ka Tilifemuso
bridge: Espagnol kan, i na ‘para que’ ma n’a filè, ‘porque’ ma jògòo filè, anglais kan, ‘so that’ ka ‘because (of)’ no ma. K’a kan fanga la, ‘so that’ tè ka kòlò klaùso (sujet + verbe) kan, ‘because of’ tè ka kòlò nòomlan. Nka, anglais kan, ‘so’ (b’a y’a ka ‘that’ taa) ma tilifemuso filè, espagnol kan, ‘así que’ an ka ‘por lo tanto’ no ma.
rule:
Anglais kan n’a, jògòo ka tilifemuso filè, i na fòlòw structùr wòro:
- **N’a:** ‘so that’ (para que) + klaùso kan verbe modal (can, could, will, would) an ka prejentan simpo. A ka ‘I study so that I can pass the exam.’ ma. ‘In order to’ (para) + infinitif an ka ye, nka a bena fanga.
- **Jògòo:** ‘because’ (porque) + klaùso, an ka ‘because of’ (debido a) + nòomlan an ka sintagma nominal. A ka ‘She stayed home because she was sick’ (klaùso) vs. ‘She stayed home because of the rain’ (nòomlan).
- **Tilifemuso:** ‘so’ (así que) + tilifemuso klaùso. A ka ‘It was raining, so we stayed home.’ ma. ‘Therefore’ (por lo tanto) an ka ye, nka a bena fanga.
- **Espagnol kan k’a kan fanga la:** Espagnol kan, ‘para que’ ka subjonctif nafa (‘para que estudies’), nka anglais kan, indicatif (saba ‘can’ an ka ‘could’ ye). ‘So’ (tilifemuso) ka ‘so that’ (n’a) fanga tèna.

title: Common Phrasal Verbs / Verbo Frasa Kanw ye
bridge: Espagnol kan, verbo waa ye a b'a fana ka k'a flɛ ka a yé fana (tɛmɛ, 'levantar', 'apagar'), amma anglais kan, phrasal verbs ka verbo ye ka a faara daara ka tɛmɛtigɛ (up, down, off, n'i tunani) ka k'a flɛ ka a yé fana an ka tɛmɛtigɛ na. Tɛmɛmaw, 'get up' tun'a flɛntɔ 'conseguir arriba', amma 'levantarse'. Kɔrɔninw ye ka tɛmɛtigɛ woto ka mana b'a faara daara an ka tɛmɛtigɛ mana b'a faara daara, nka taara, phrasal verbs ka a faara daara, tɛmɛtigɛ ka a faara daara ka k'a flɛ ka a yé fana (tɛmɛ, 'turn the TV off' an ka 'turn off the TV'), n'i tun'a yé espagnol kan.
rule: Phrasal verb ye verbo ye ka tɛmɛtigɛ an ka faara daara. Tɛmɛtigɛ ka faara daara an ka tɛmɛmaw b'a faara daara ye ka k'a flɛ ka a yé fana. A ka kɔrɔ, a be se ka k'a faara daara ye ka k'a yé fana. Phrasal verbs ka ye ye fasa ye: transitif ye ka intransitif ye. Transitif ye ka a faara daara ye ka a faara daara ye ka a faara daara ye. A faara daara ye ka a faara daara ye ka a faara daara ye ka a faara daara ye (tɛmɛ, 'turn it off' (ka 'turn off it')). A faara daara ye ka a faara daara ye ka a faara daara ye ka a faara daara ye (tɛmɛ, 'look after the children' (ka 'look children after')). Phrasal verbs woto ye ka intransitif ye ka a faara daara ye ka a faara daara ye: 'wake up', 'grow up'. A ka kɔrɔ, a be se ka k'a faara daara ye ka k'a yé fana ye ka k'a faara daara ye. B1 tɔgɔ, phrasal verbs kanw ye: get up, wake up, turn on/off, put on, take off, look for, look after, find out, give up, go on, come back, n'i tunani.

title: Advanced Quantifiers / Kɔjiriw kanbɛw
bridge: A taali gi, an b'a boɲafɛnw bɛɛ min na 'pocos', 'bastantes', 'casi ningún' ka kɔjiriw dɔw kɛ, nka, a ye tiiba jaabi ye ajɛw kɔjiriw kanbɛw bɛɛ ka min na 'hardly any', 'plenty of' ye ajɛw kɔjiriw kanbɛw bɛ min na 'much/many'. Kɔjiriw kanbɛw woto ka sira kɛyɔrɔ bɛ a filɛ: 'hardly any' ka min 'casi' ye 'ninguno' ka ye afɔlɔ kanu, 'plenty of' minkɛ 'más que suficiente' an ka ye 'mucho'. Kɛlɛya, feemɛn feemɛ fɔlɔ, 'plenty of' b'a boɲafɛn bɛ min na kɔjiriw kanbɛw bɛɛ ka min na 'much/many'.
rule: Kɔjiriw kanbɛw kanbɛw (B1) a taali gi kɛ: 'hardly any' (casi ningún/ninguno) ka boɲafɛn bɛ min na kɔjiriw kanbɛw bɛɛ ka min na 'very few' wala 'very little'. 'Plenty of' (bastante, más que suficiente) ka boɲafɛn bɛ min na kɔjiriw kanbɛw bɛɛ ka min na 'much/many' (a ye tiiba jaabi ye ajɛw kɔjiriw kanbɛw bɛɛ). Kɔjiriw kanbɛw kanbɛw woto: 'a good deal of' (bastante, formal, incontables), 'a large amount of' (una gran cantidad de, incontables), 'a large number of' (un gran número de, contables), 'a couple of' (un par de, contables). Kɛlɛya, 'plenty of' ka boɲafɛn bɛ min na kɔjiriw kanbɛw bɛɛ ka min na 'much/many'. 'Hardly any' ka boɲafɛn bɛ min na kɔjiriw kanbɛw bɛɛ ka min na 'very few' wala 'very little'.

title: Verb patterns: verb + infinitive / gerund / Faranbɔgɔla kanw: faranbɔgɔla + infinitif / gerundif
bridge: A taali gi, faranbɔgɔla kɛmɛbokoo ra, i tun man na tɛ infinitif la (mɛn walisa 'ayin na fun', 'mɛn tɛ aw ka sɔrɔ'). Nka, a anglesekan, faranbɔgɔla wɛrɛ (mɛn walisa 'enjoy', 'avoid', 'finish') na gerundif (-ing) kan, nka faranbɔgɔla wɛrɛ (mɛn walisa 'want', 'decide', 'hope') na 'to' bla infinitif kan. O fisa, faranbɔgɔla wɛrɛ bɛɛ ka tugu ka sɔrɔ bɛ ka tɔgɔ bɛ na i tun man na tɛ infinitif wala gerundif la (mɛn walisa 'stop to smoke' ka 'stop smoking' ye). Kɛlɛya la jati fana ka sɔrɔ a ka anglesegi sɔrɔla kɛlɛya ra.
rule: A anglesekan, faranbɔgɔla kɛmɛbokoo bɛ ka tɔgɔ bɛ na faranbɔgɔla din ye: 'to' bla infinitif (I want to go) wala gerundif (-ing) (I enjoy going). I tun man na tɛ fisa faranbɔgɔla kɛmɛbokoo ra. Faranbɔgɔla kanw bɛɛ: - Faranbɔgɔla bɛ na infinitif kan: want, need, decide, hope, plan, promise, agree, offer, forget, learn, lanw ye. - Faranbɔgɔla bɛ na gerundif kan: enjoy, finish, avoid, mind, consider, suggest, practice, admit, deny, lanw ye. - Faranbɔgɔla bɛ na i tun man na tɛ tugu ka sɔrɔ bɛ: start, begin, continue, like, love, hate, prefer. - Faranbɔgɔla bɛ ka tugu ka sɔrɔ bɛ: remember, forget, stop, try, regret. (Mɛn walisa 'Remember to lock the door' = taa la tɛ aw ka sara; 'Remember locking the door' = aw ka sara ka taa la taa ye). Fɛɛri: faranbɔgɔla bɛ na aw ka di a ka fɔlɔ (I saw him leave, They made me wait) kɔfɛ, 'make' la 'let' la, i tun man na tɛ 'to' bla infinitif. Musow bɛ na 'not' ka tɛ infinitif wala gerundif jɔn (I decided not to go, I enjoy not working).

title: Articles Advanced: Zero Article and Generic Use / Sitɔri Kɛmɛkulu: Sitɔri Bɛɛnninlo kanu Sitɔri Kɛmɛkulu
bridge: A taali gianii ra, i sɔrɔ sitɔri kɛmɛkulu la a bɔ dɔɲɛɲu kanw bɛɛ (mɛn ko, 'les chiens sont fidèles'). A taali angɛlɛkan ra, o bɔlo sitɔri o bɛɛnnin lo ale ka kɛ: 'Dogs are loyal'. Kɔfɛ kanw ye ko i ka jamana ka alamadenw bɛɛna o kɔrɔ: i ka ci o kɔrɔ 'The dogs are loyal' angɛlɛkan ra, o kɔrɔ se ka i ka jamana ka alamadenw ka kɛ i goɲɛn fɛ. Angɛlɛkan ra, o bɔlo sitɔri o bɛɛnnin lo a ka kɛ a bɔ dɔɲɛɲu kanw bɛɛ ye (mɛn ko, 'I like rice'), hal a taali gianii ra, a bɔli a bɛɛnnin lo kɛ (mɛn ko, 'Me gusta el arroz').
rule: Angɛlɛkan ra, sitɔri bɛɛnninlo kanw ye fɔlɔ fɔlɔ kɔ: 1) A bɔ dɔɲɛɲu kanw bɛɛ a ka kɛ a bɔ sɔrɔninpluriel kanu sɔrɔnincountable kanw (mɛn ko, 'Cats are cute', 'Water is essential'). 2) A bɔ dɔɲɛɲu kanw bɛɛ ye, alamadenw kanu, spor kanu, kɛ fɛn kanu akademi kanw bɛɛnnin lo ale ka kɛ o bɔlo kɛmɛ kanu (mɛn ko, 'I speak English', 'She plays tennis'). 3) A bɔ dɔɲɛɲu kanw bɛɛ ye, istitisyon kanw bɛnnin lo ale ka kɛ 'school', 'hospital', 'church', 'prison' a ka kɛ i ka tɔgɔyaya kɛmɛkulu (mɛn ko, 'He goes to school' - ka tɛmɛna, o bɔlo ka tɔgɔyaya). Kɛlɛya: sɔrɔnin singulier kanu countable kanw ra, a bɔ sitɔri o bɔ determiner kanu, dɔɲɛɲufɛɛ, a bɔ sɔrɔnin kɛmɛkulu (mɛn ko, 'A dog is man's best friend' o 'The dog is a loyal animal'). O bɔlo kɛ 'Dog is loyal' a ka kɛ a bɔ dɔɲɛɲu kanw bɛɛ. Kɛfɛna, angɛlɛkan ra, o bɔlo 'the' a bɔ alamadenw kanw bɛɛnnin lo ale ka kɛ i ka fɛn politiki bɛɛnnin lo (mɛn ko, 'Italy', 'Spain'), nka, o bɔli a bɛɛnnin lo kɛ alamadenw kanw ka kɛ 'republic', 'kingdom' o 'states' (mɛn ko, 'the United States').

examples.original: They go to church every Sunday.
examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ ɡəʊ tə tʃɜːtʃ ˈevri ˈsʌndeɪ/
examples.translation: Ils vont à l'église tous les dimanches.
examples.note: A bɔ a bɔ tɔgɔyaya kɛmɛkulu ra, o bɔlo sitɔri. A bɔ a bɔ visitana, o kɔrɔ 'to the church'.

examples.original: We went to bed early.
examples.phonetic: /wiː went tə bed ˈɜːli/
examples.translation: Nous nous couchons tôt.
examples.note: Fɔlɔfɔlɔ kanw bɛnnin lo ale ka kɛ 'go to bed', 'go to work', 'at home' o bɔlo sitɔri.

translations.bm: Sitɔri kɛmɛkulu: sitɔri bɛɛnninlo kanu sitɔri kɛmɛkulu
